With NOWPayments' 0.5% fee, at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference retains $921. This post breaks down [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-about-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-webhook-driven-crypto-payment-fulfillment-explained-digital-3|COREMERCH guide to cloudflare]]-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks-guide|everything]] you need to know about Bitcoin payments for digital downloads without relying on Stripe or other platforms.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure is not a workaround for platform restrictions, but a base-layer solution that gives digital creators full control over their digital stores and payments. By using GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Supabase, and NOWPayments, creators can deploy a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This means no more relying on platforms like Stripe or Gumroad, with their hefty fees and restrictive terms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure is built on a combination of free and paid tools that work together seamlessly. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host the store, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle the backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets store orders, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver files instantly. NOWPayments handles automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, with a 0.5% fee and no KYC or buyer account requirements.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
Automated delivery means the download link arrives before the buyer navigates away from the payment confirmation page.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure today, start by purchasing the Complete Builder Kit ($197) - all 6 blueprints plus all 7 templates - which includes everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. Next, follow the checklist below to deploy your infrastructure. Visit our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to purchase the Complete Builder Kit and start building your sovereign commerce stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Every digital file type — ebooks, fonts, presets, plugins, templates — works with the same automated delivery pipeline.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
